issues.desc: index.json description attributes "an rm-during-read reader-writer race" to B-fb7b's FIRST Codex round (paired with the lock age-steal), but background.md's Key Insights numbered (1)-(4) list -- which both documents claim enumerates the same four Codex findings -- has no matching item for a reader-writer race; its 4th item is instead "(4) existence-only reuse ... reuses a present dist with no freshness proof." Neither document states these are the same finding under different wording, so a standalone reader cannot tell if there are 4 or 5 distinct historical findings.

The abbreviation "YAGNI" (background.md Solution Tradeoffs: "Deliberately NOT doing atomic-publish/symlink dist-swap (YAGNI; Windows symlink permissions are fragile)"; also scope-boundary.json excluded list) is never expanded on first appearance. Inferable from context for an engineering reader, but not spelled out per Dimension 1 convention.
